Here is a professional cover letter for the Backend Engineer position at LaunchAI:

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Backend Engineer position at LaunchAI, where I can leverage my technical expertise to build a scalable and efficient backend platform from scratch. With a strong foundation in software engineering and a passion for AI, I am confident that I can make a valuable contribution to your team.

As a software engineer intern at Google, I gained hands-on experience in designing and implementing a new linting rule and automated batch validation pipeline in Java and TypeScript. I also enhanced core template management interfaces by developing a responsive document comparison dialog box, a read/write mode selector for gDoc, and an embedded AI assistant chat widget. These experiences not only honed my skills in Java and TypeScript but also taught me the importance of collaboration, code review, and continuous integration.

In my previous roles, I have had the opportunity to work on various projects that have helped me develop a strong understanding of backend engineering. At Code Fusion, I built a CRDT-based real-time collaborative code editor using Yjs and Monaco Editor, which enabled conflict-free multi-user editing through delta-based synchronization and awareness protocol for live cursor tracking across sessions. I also developed a real-time collaboration system supporting live cursor tracking and integrated in-app chat, allowing seamless communication between distributed developers during shared coding sessions.

At JobPilot, I developed an automation system using FastAPI, Next.js, and HuggingFace LLMs to automate resume extraction and job matching, reducing manual application time by 80%. I also architected a scalable asynchronous worker system with WebSockets/Socket.IO updates and FileLock synchronization to manage concurrent multi-user job lifecycles.

I am particularly drawn to LaunchAI's mission to build a scalable and efficient backend platform, and I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to this effort. My experience with FastAPI, Next.js, and LLMs has given me a strong foundation in building scalable and efficient backend systems. I am confident that my skills and experience make me an ideal candidate for this role.

Thank you for considering my application. I would be thrilled to discuss this opportunity further and explain in greater detail why I am the perfect fit for this role.

Sincerely,
Anirban Das
